effect_description_eng:
[All Turns] While this Digimon's digivolution cards include a card with [Gammamon] in its name, this Digimon gains ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.).
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Gammamon] from your trash suspended without paying its memory cost.
